title: Zesty Irish Cheese Fondue
description: A buttery and nostalgic Irish dish featuring a rich cheese fondue served with baguette and dum, dairy-free friendly options available. Perfect for a fun and interactive snack or appetizer.
instructions: In a large fondue pot, combine the shredded vegan Irish cheddar, melted butter, minced garlic, lemon juice, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly until the cheese is melted and smooth.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until it reaches 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the fondue is cooking, prepare the baguette and dum by cutting the baguette into 1 inch cubes and cooking the dum according to package instructions.
Once the fondue is ready, arrange the baguette cubes and dum on a platter or individual plates.
Serve the fondue hot, with the baguette and dum on the side for dipping.
Encourage guests to dip the baguette and dum into the fondue, enjoying the rich and creamy cheese sauce.
If desired, add additional ingredients such as chopped herbs or diced vegetables to the fondue for added flavor and nutrition.
